rationale.edition: All three changed files live in open-source locations: web/src/views/Dashboards/ViewDashboard.vue, web/src/views/Dashboards/viewDashboard.timeRange.spec.ts, and tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/dashboard-variables-auto-run.spec.js. None sit under enterprise-owned directories (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/), and none carry enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/sensitive/logo) in their paths or symbols, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: No explicit opt-out is present: trigger_comment.txt is empty and no tests-added/skip label was passed. The change is user-facing, not docs/CI-only, because ViewDashboard.vue alters the visible dashboard refresh button (variant outline to primary, size, a new visible 'Refresh' label, and a tooltip wrapper), so the skip gate does not apply.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: the refresh button is a real interactive dashboard control users see and click, and its variant, label, and tooltip are user-facing state changes that affect the rendering and semantics of the refresh action across idle, pending, and Auto Run states.
rationale.area: The bulk of the UI change is in web/src/views/Dashboards/ViewDashboard.vue, and the diff also touches a Dashboards Playwright spec and a Dashboards Vitest spec, so the feature belongs in the Dashboards area where its sibling specs live.
rationale.group: The feature is a dashboard UI change, so the closest matrix shard follows the Dashboards-* convention; 'Dashboards' is proposed as the shard name. The OSS ci_matrix.json is not present in this checkout (only the enterprise .ent overlay), so the Engineer should confirm the existing OSS Dashboards shard name and add the spec there.
rationale.existing_tests: Yes: the diff modifies the Playwright E2E spec tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/dashboard-variables-auto-run.spec.js, whose assertion expectRefreshVariant('outline') was updated to 'primary', so it already covers part of the new variant behavior. The web/src/views/Dashboards/viewDashboard.timeRange.spec.ts change is a Vitest unit test, not an E2E spec, so it is not counted as E2E coverage; the labelled button and tooltip aspects may still need complementing E2E coverage.
